oath.track: Take an oath from a shrine knight and bring it to Maren.
lines: You're awake. Good. I wasn't sure I remembered you well enough.
There are knights at the old shrines. They swore to guard our dead, and they still do, though they've forgotten why.
Beat one and bring me what it carries. An oath is a memory with a purpose. It will help you remember yours.
reminder: The knights keep to the old shrines, out past the fields. Bring me what one carries.
doneLines: That's an oath, all right. Hold still.
There. That's yours now. You fought like that once, I think.

keep.track: Defeat the Warden in the keep north of the village, and bring Maren what he held onto.
lines: The smithy's cold because no one here remembers how to work it.
Bram's apprentice took the forge up to the old keep to keep it safe. He's been up there so long he's forgotten everything else.
He won't give it back. Bring me what he held onto, and the forge with it.
reminder: The keep is north, up in the hills. He won't come quietly.
doneLines: He held onto this so hard it's still warm.
There. That's yours too. Use it carefully.

forge.track: Rebuild the smithy with what the Warden kept.
lines: You brought the forge back, too. The smithy needs wood and stone before it can take it.
Rebuild it, and someone may remember the way home.
reminder: The smithy is just past the fire. Wood, stone, and what you took from the keep.
doneLines: Bram came back. I'd almost forgotten his face.
